trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, and it needs nothing on its own. There is no online requirement and no DLC requirement, so a single offline playthrough is enough. Follow the Planner order and the platinum is the last line on the list, not a separate job.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, so it comes to you: play the story from the start and finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission, and the trophy pops at its end. Nothing here can be missed, and there is no side requirement to prepare. It is the first story trophy on the Planner for that reason.
steps: Start the story and play through the opening until Gone Fishing begins.
Finish the mission as directed; the trophy unlocks when it ends.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end and this unlocks automatically with the chapter's final mission. The story is five chapters long and takes roughly 60 to 80 hours, so Chapter 1 is the early stretch, not a grind. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that cannot wait: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, which PowerPyx flags as the game's only possibly missable trophy.
steps: Play Chapter 1's missions in order until the chapter closes.
Before the chapter ends, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic story progress, so there is no separate task to hunt down. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals with the binoculars as you travel between missions, since that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist that appears after the story.
steps: Play Chapter 2's missions in order until the chapter closes.
Scan new vehicles and study animals along the way; the checklist counts it later.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 and this unlocks with its closing mission. By this point both protagonists are in play, so switch between Jason and Lucia when the story allows it: some side strands only open for one of them. There is nothing missable in the chapter itself, and free roam after the story covers anything you skipped.
steps: Play Chapter 3's missions in order until the chapter closes.
Switch characters when the game allows it to keep both strands of side content open.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at its end. This is the second-to-last chapter trophy, so the story is nearly done and the free-roam cleanup is close. Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter: the game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, and there is no mission replay, so saves are your only safety net.
steps: Make a manual save as Chapter 4 begins.
Play the chapter's missions in order until it closes.
Make another manual save as the chapter ends.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the story's finish line: complete the final mission and it pops. Finishing the story also unlocks the 100% Completion checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, which is where the real platinum work begins. After the credits you stay in free roam, so nothing in the story needs to be replayed to keep going.
steps: Finish the final mission to close the story.
Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to see the checklist for Stage 2.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops at its end. It is a named story mission rather than a chapter milestone, so it unlocks in the natural course of playing through the chapters. No preparation or side activity is needed for it.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story and play it through.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Heist missions are story beats, so this one arrives on its own as you play the chapters through. Keep a manual save before starting it, as you should before any big story mission, since missions cannot be replayed.
steps: Make a manual save before the heist.
Reach The Cartel Heist in the story and play it through to the end.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play and the trophy pops at its end. Like the other named-mission trophies it is automatic: reach the mission in the story, finish it, and move on. There is no extra condition attached to it.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story and play it through.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners and the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is another named story mission, so it comes with normal story progress and cannot be missed. Play it as the story presents it and keep going.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story and play it through.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy pops at its end. VCIA is the airport, so expect this mission to take you there. It is story progress like the other named missions, with no side requirement and nothing missable about it.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story and play it through.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy unlocks when it ends. This is the last of the named story-mission trophies on the list, and like the rest it is automatic story progress. Finish it and the story trophies are done except for the final mission itself.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story and play it through.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the longest job on the list: reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy and puts the whole platinum at about 200 hours. The checklist is kinder than it sounds: it asks for roughly 60% true completion, not everything. You need 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 15 of the 18 card sets, but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range and drone race is required. Work through the Planner's Stage 2 in order and this trophy is the last one to land there.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Clear the checklist's tasks in the Planner's Stage 2 order, checking Progress often.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist reads 100%.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. Stunts cover stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps, and PowerPyx counts 397 of them across Leonida, so there is room to spare: the 100% checklist needs 300, this trophy only 250. Stunts are counted by type in the game, so mix jump types rather than repeating one spot. Do them steadily during free roam after the story, or grab them as you travel during Stage 1.
steps: Attempt stunts as you travel: jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count.
Check your stunt totals by type and favour the types you have done least.
The trophy pops at 250; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or master any of them: one attempt at each type is enough. The activity types are the game's side pastimes — fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone races, shooting ranges, races and the rest — so work through them during Stage 2 and tick each off as you sample it. This is a sampler trophy, and most of its activities feed other trophies anyway.
steps: Open the activities list and note which of the 9 types you have not tried.
Try each untried type once; winning is not required.
The trophy pops once all 9 types have been attempted.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges in total and every one of them is required, both for this silver trophy and for the 100% checklist, so there is no skipping the hard ones. PowerPyx notes the gold medals are not too difficult. Visit the ranges during Stage 2, learn each challenge's scoring, and repeat until gold; the game tracks your medals per challenge, so you can clear them a few at a time.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Play each challenge until you earn gold; your medals are tracked per challenge.
Repeat across all ranges until all 42 show gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own drone race, and you need a win at every one of them, so this is a tour of the whole map rather than a single event. The races are also required for the 100% checklist. Fly each course, learn its gates, and take the win location by location; the game tracks which locations you have won.
steps: Find a Top Fun Drone Race location and enter the race.
Win the race at that location, then move to the next.
Repeat until all 14 locations show a win.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so you need twenty distinct race events won. Races are scattered across Leonida and come in several kinds, and the wins also feed the 100% checklist. Work through the race list during Stage 2, one new race at a time, and check your win count per race as you go.
steps: Enter a race you have not won yet.
Win it, then pick a different race next time.
Repeat until 20 different races show a win.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival, so this is a head-to-head fishing contest rather than free fishing: you need to out-fish him in the challenge itself. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None. Find Cal's challenge, fish it as the game directs, and beat his catch.
steps: Find Cal and take on his fishing challenge.
Fish the challenge as directed and out-catch Cal.
The trophy pops when you beat him.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest or easiest one you find and play it through. Arcade games are one of the 9 activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None. There is no score target named in the description, just a completion.
steps: Find an arcade machine and start a game.
Play it through to its end.
The trophy pops on completion.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is a side questline with several missions, and this trophy is for its last one. KeenGamer reports Andy's quests are Lucia-only, so play them as Lucia. The strand can be finished after the story in free roam, and KeenGamer notes that quest givers tied to trophies return after the story, so there is no rush — but do not leave it to the very end either, since the strand feeds Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play as Lucia and find Andy's strand.
Work through Andy's missions in order.
Complete the final mission for Andy.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand is one of the side questlines that ends in its own trophy, and it can be finished after the story in free roam. Work through his missions in order and the trophy pops at the last one. Like the other stranger finals, it counts toward the Strangers & Freaks silver trophy.
steps: Find Kenton's strand and take his missions.
Work through them in order.
Complete the final mission for Kenton.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is another side questline with its own closing trophy, finishable after the story in free roam. Play his missions in order and the trophy pops at the last one. It also counts toward the Strangers & Freaks silver trophy, so it is part of Stage 3's cleanup.
steps: Find Billy's strand and take his missions.
Work through them in order.
Complete the final mission for Billy.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is a whole questline for one stranger, not a single mission, and PowerPyx notes it is still confirming exactly which side questlines count — so do not assume every stranger qualifies. The five named strand finals on this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are the safe core, plus Bret's hunting strand and two more that PowerPyx confirms. All of them can be finished after the story in free roam, and quest givers tied to trophies return after the story.
steps: Finish the named stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Check PowerPyx's guide for which other strands count toward the 8.
The trophy pops when the eighth qualifying strand is complete.
trophies.note: PowerPyx is still confirming which side questlines count toward the 8; the five named strand finals plus Bret are the safe core.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's strand is one of the side questlines with its own closing trophy, and it can be finished after the story in free roam. Work through his missions in order and the trophy pops at the last one. It counts toward the Strangers & Freaks silver trophy.
steps: Find Randy's strand and take his missions.
Work through them in order.
Complete the final mission for Randy.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand is a side questline with its own closing trophy, finishable after the story in free roam. KeenGamer reports Tyrone's quests are Jason-only, so play them as Jason. Work through his missions in order and the trophy pops at the last one; it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play as Jason and find Tyrone's strand.
Work through Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one possibly missable trophy: PowerPyx flags the first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house, as missable in Chapter 1, and KeenGamer gives the exact moment — after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. Do that before Chapter 1 ends. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The remaining spots are found across the map in free roam, and the game tracks how many you have done. Push Square lists no known missables, so the guides disagree — but the safe play costs nothing: do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and follow her to the balcony to meditate. Do this before Chapter 1 ends.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when both characters are playable, meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida.
Check your meditation count as you go; the trophy pops at 18.
trophies.note: PowerPyx flags the Chapter 1 balcony meditation as possibly missable; Push Square lists no known missables. Doing it in Chapter 1 is the safe play either way.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is a hunting questline, and this trophy is for taking down the one unique animal he asks for. KeenGamer reports Bret's quests are Jason-only, so hunt as Jason. The 100% checklist requires all of Bret's quests, so this strand does double duty: it feeds both this trophy and the checklist. No published guide has yet pinned down the animal's exact location, so follow Bret's missions as they come rather than hunting blind.
steps: Play as Jason and take Bret's hunting missions.
Follow Bret's strand until he marks the unique animal.
Hunt the unique animal as Bret directs.
trophies.note: No published guide has yet pinned down the unique animal's exact location; follow Bret's missions rather than hunting blind.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game and the 100% checklist needs 15 of them, so this silver trophy is an early milestone on a longer hunt: three full sets is enough here, fifteen is the real target. Cards are found across Leonida, and each set needs every card in it. Pick the sets nearest your route, finish three, and keep collecting — the rest feed A Long Road.
steps: Collect cards as you explore; each set needs all of its cards.
Finish any 3 complete sets.
Keep collecting afterward: the 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the game's in-world photo-sharing app: take a WAiNK photo at 100 different spots across Leonida. The count is the whole job — there is no quality bar named in the description, just coverage. The checklist also counts 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Spread the photos across your travels instead of grinding them in one place.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at a new location and take the photo.
Repeat at new spots as you travel; repeats at the same spot do not count.
The trophy pops at 100 locations.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of them, so 50 is a waypoint on the way to 70. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and more, and each one you finish counts. Work through the easiest groups first and skip the hardest ones — the checklist lets you skip ten, and this trophy lets you stop at fifty.
steps: Open the Challenges list and pick a group you have barely touched.
Complete challenges, starting with the easiest in each group.
The trophy pops at 50; keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape. You need your partner beside you when the heat comes off, so this is a co-op moment in free roam, not a solo escape. Sixshore notes it is possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2, and that bank jobs give 4 stars anyway — so the simplest route is to start a bank job with your partner along, then break the line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
steps: Bring your partner along in free roam once both characters can roam together (Chapter 2 onward).
Raise a 4-star Wanted Level — a bank job does this on its own.
Break line of sight, stay hidden, and escape with your partner still with you.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the second half of the sentence: you must keep the Wanted Level you have — losing it between shops breaks the chain, so do not let the heat drop to zero until the third shop is done. Plan a short route with three shops close together, bring your partner, and hit them one after another without stopping to hide.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop to raise a Wanted Level.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back before the Wanted Level clears.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery means finding and scanning a vehicle you have not seen before — the checklist counts 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so 100 is the halfway mark on a longer scan. Scan every new vehicle you pass during the story and the count climbs without a grind: the game tracks which models you have found. Keep scanning in free roam after the story until the trophy pops, then keep going to 200 for the checklist.
steps: Scan every vehicle model you have not seen before as you travel.
Check your discovered-vehicle count in Progress.
The trophy pops at 100; keep scanning to 200 for the 100% checklist.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode, so the setup matters more than the shooting: find a spot with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it runs out. Missions and gang operations with grouped enemies are the natural place to try it. If you fall short, reload a save and try a denser fight.
steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take all five down before it ends.
If you run short, reload and try a denser fight.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description is deliberately vague, and no published guide has yet confirmed the exact move, so the honest reading is the literal one: leave the airport in a way the airport did not schedule, most likely by taking off in a plane yourself rather than boarding a flight. Try it in free roam after the story, when the airport is open to you, and expect the trophy to pop on departure. If it does not, no guide has yet published a confirmed alternative.
steps: Go to VCIA, the airport, in free roam.
Get hold of a plane and take off yourself instead of boarding a scheduled flight.
The trophy should pop on departure; if it does not, no confirmed method is published yet.
trophies.note: No published guide has yet confirmed the exact move; the guide gives the literal reading of the description and says so.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is the tank, and the description is a joke about the heat inside one — so this trophy is about doing something in a Rhino tank. No published guide has yet confirmed what that something is: surviving a wanted level in one, taking enemies down with it, or simply driving one are all plausible, and the description alone does not say which. The honest advice is to get into a Rhino in free roam, cause a stir with the police, and see what pops; do not trust any guide that claims a confirmed method yet, because none has published one.
steps: Find a Rhino tank in free roam.
Drive it and stir up a wanted level with it.
No confirmed method is published yet — try the tank in combat and watch for the pop.
trophies.note: No published guide has yet confirmed the exact requirement; the guide gives only the lead the description itself offers.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Detection is the whole condition: the robbery itself is easy, staying unseen is the job. Case the store first, go in quiet, take what you came for and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails the condition, so back out and try again rather than fighting your way out.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its layout before going in.
Rob it quietly, avoiding staff and cameras.
Leave undetected; if you are spotted, back out and try again.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, each one ending in a clean getaway. Bank vaults are the big robberies: KeenGamer's reading of the checklist counts 22 bank jobs and 8 bank vault robberies in total, so vaults are a subset with their own demands. Do them one at a time, escape after each, and the game tracks how many vaults you have cleared. Five is the trophy; eight is what the checklist wants.
steps: Find a bank vault job and rob it.
Escape cleanly after each vault.
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed and escaped; keep going to 8 for the checklist.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, so find one on a route, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police close in. The escape is part of the trophy, not an afterthought: the job is not done until you are clear. This is the smallest of the robbery trophies and a good first one.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and rob the cash.
Escape the police to finish the job.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The state is divided into 52 named areas and the game tracks which ones you have visited, so this is a map-completion trophy: set foot in every area and it pops. Explore as you travel during the story and you will clear most of them without trying; after the story, open the map, find the areas you have never entered, and drive through each one. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good, since new areas bring new vehicles to scan.
steps: Explore new areas as you travel during the story.
After the story, open the map and note the areas you have never visited.
Drive through each remaining area until all 52 are visited.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida, and you need to hit one per gang — nine robberies in total, one for each gang's turf. KeenGamer's reading of the checklist counts 39 gang operations overall, so there are far more targets than the nine you need. Learn which gang holds which operation, hit one of each, and escape after each one.
steps: Find an Illegal Operation and note which gang runs it.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for a different gang each time until all 9 gangs are hit.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole lead: go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view — a bar or a beachfront seat — and have a cocktail there. No published guide has yet confirmed the exact spot or the exact interaction, so this guide does not invent one. Head to Ocean Beach, look for a place to sit with a drink and a view, and try it there.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar or seat with a view of the beach.
Have a cocktail there.
trophies.note: No published guide has yet confirmed the exact spot; the guide gives only the lead the description itself offers.

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points at a showroom and a smash-out, in the style of the series' classic moments — driving a car through the glass and out onto the street. No published guide has yet confirmed which showroom or the exact trigger, so this guide does not invent one. The lead is plain enough: take a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the front.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get a car inside it.
Drive the car out through the showroom front.
No confirmed method is published yet — try the obvious smash-out first.
trophies.note: No published guide has yet confirmed the exact showroom or trigger; the guide gives only the lead the description itself offers.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The name and the description point at the same place: the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates. Go there, bowl, and follow through — the description's wording suggests completing the bowling action itself rather than just showing up. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Bowl a game there and follow through on your throws.
The trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives almost nothing away, and no published guide has yet confirmed what this trophy asks for. The words suggest doing something with your partner that draws a crowd — a public moment with Lucia or Jason at your side — but that is a reading of the description, not a confirmed method. This guide says so plainly rather than inventing a location or a step: watch for a confirmed method in the published guides, and in the meantime try partner activities that put the two of you in front of a crowd.
steps: No confirmed method is published yet.
The description suggests a public moment with your partner; try partner activities in front of crowds.
Check the published guides for a confirmed method before grinding for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count for this one up to 500, so it is a volume trophy: keep making choices — story decisions, side-quest decisions, dialogue choices — and the count climbs. There is no single moment to aim for and no way to miss it, since choices happen all through the game. Play normally, take the choices as they come, and it will pop in the course of a full playthrough.
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them — story, side quests, dialogue.
Check the PSN-tracked count in your trophy progress.
The trophy pops at 500 choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description is a shrug, not an instruction, and no published guide has yet confirmed what this trophy asks for. Watch for a confirmed method in the published guides; until one appears, treat any second-attempt success as a candidate and keep playing.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. The description names the move: a drive-by attack using a melee weapon, knocking people down like bowling pins. The name is the bowling pun and the method is in the sentence — drive past on a vehicle and strike with a melee weapon. No published guide has yet confirmed the exact spot or the number of targets, so the guide gives only what the description says: a melee drive-by, done from a moving vehicle.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a group of people and strike with the melee weapon as you pass.
The trophy pops when the drive-by lands; no confirmed target count is published yet.
trophies.note: No published guide has yet confirmed the exact spot or target count; the guide gives only the move the description names.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies, and your contacts clean them for a cut — the trophy counts the laundered earnings, not the raw haul. Robberies are the supply: bank vaults, gang operations and shop robberies all feed the pile of marked bills. Launder them through your contacts as you go, and the trophy pops once $250,000 of clean money has come back to you.
steps: Rob banks, gang operations and shops to build up Marked Bills.
Launder the Marked Bills through your contacts.
The trophy pops once $250,000 has been laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop counts and the spending adds up across all of them, so this is a slow-burn trophy that fills as you buy weapons, clothes, cars and everything else the game sells. There is no single big purchase required. Just keep shopping through the playthrough — by the time the laundering and garage trophies are done, this one is usually close too.
steps: Buy what you need at any shop; all spending counts toward the total.
Check your total spent in Progress.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought, not earned, so this trophy is a money job: save up, buy each garage property as you can afford it, and the trophy pops when the eighth is yours. Garages also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them as your collection grows rather than all at the end.
steps: Save money from robberies, missions and laundering.
Buy each garage property as you can afford it.
The trophy pops when all 8 garages are yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app is the in-game service for registering vehicles you own, so find ten vehicles worth keeping, get them into your garages, and register each one through the app. Any ten vehicles count — there is no rarity requirement in the description. Do it as your collection grows, and the trophy pops at the tenth registration.
steps: Collect vehicles you want to keep and store them in your garages.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register a vehicle.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
